title: Man Reveals Where He Buried The Body 15 Years Ago
description:
This case, which spans over a decade, will send chills down your spine. On the afternoon of December 23rd, 2008, a boy approached his local police station because his father had not contacted the family for 10 days. The police began searching for him throughout the town, but no clues were found. They learned that he had some trouble with his tenant recently, but even the tenant had no idea where he had gone. There were no activities in his bank account either. The case hit a dead end and was closed—until 911 received a call on May 1st, 2023, 15 years later. The caller was none other than the person who had k*lled the boy’s father and buried him under his own residence. The police discovered that he had used someone else’s phone to make the 911 call. According to police reports from 2008 and 2009, the boy’s father’s ex-girlfriend, Joan, received a note from his girlfriend, Mona, stating that he had not returned home. On the day he was murdered, he had gone to feed Joan’s dogs because she was out of town. The last time she spoke to him, he mentioned that he had a fight with his tenant, who had stolen his wallet. A month after the man was murdered, police searched his house but could not find any clues. The only detail mentioned in the reports was that the house appeared undisturbed, except for a rotten smell from leftover food on the table and dead vermin. The man was then listed as missing. All the dots were about to be connected after the murderer revealed the truth to the police. The next few minutes will be his confession of how he murdered the man, which may be disturbing to some viewers. We advise discretion. It became clear to the police that he was the same tenant mentioned in the 2009 reports. He took them to the man’s house and showed them where he had buried the body. They began uncovering each body part, piece by piece. The police found the victim’s shoes and later while excavating, his skull, jawbone, rib cage and other body parts were found. The dentures confirmed that the body belonged to William, the boy’s father. Based on the evidence, the man was charged with 1st degree m*rder.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
